description.value: Blenz is a BC-based specialty coffee chain offering handcrafted espresso drinks, whole-leaf teas, protein shakes, and a broad selection of baked goods, sandwiches, and wraps. This Tsawwassen location sits in a retail unit on 56th Street and has outdoor seating, making it a practical stop for cyclists moving through the South Delta area. Online ordering and a loyalty app are available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Blenz Coffee franchise at 101–1315 56th Street, Delta BC V4L 2A6, with phone 604-943-1981, matching OSM. The food menu page lists dietary filter options including 'gluten free', 'dairy free', and 'vegan', confirming vegetarian/vegan/GF options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or device charging anywhere in the website content; OSM outdoor_seating=yes is noted but insufficient alone to confirm bike visibility.
concerns: OSM opening hours (Mo-Sa 07:00-18:00; Su 07:00-17:00, surveyed 2026-01-15) differ from website hours (Mon-Sat 7AM-7PM; Sun 7AM-5PM) — website shows later weekday closing time (7PM vs 6PM). Website hours should be treated as more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active coffee shop confirmed open by website content and recent OSM survey. Useful stop for touring cyclists in Tsawwassen for food, drinks, and takeout.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Food menu page includes dietary filter options for 'gluten free', 'dairy free', and 'vegan', with specific items labelled accordingly (e.g. dairy-free Dacaron™ varieties)
